identity.face_index: zero-based raw OCCT TopExp traversal order used by the audited generator; accepted only when annotation ids are canonical and contiguous, bottom covers the same ids, imported BRep is valid and build123d faces are IsSame position-by-position with an independent raw traversal

policy.development: May be scanned to find and describe gaps. Counts are diagnostic, not a definition.
policy.holdout: Keep outcomes sealed until a semantic child has two independent pre-reveal ACCEPT verdicts. Both holdout and all-selection scans require an explicit reveal flag. After reveal it becomes regression evidence and must not be fitted.
policy.named_allocations: Each allocation requires its exact acknowledgement and remains excluded from unselected after consumption. F5-FLATS-H1 and F5-FILLETS-H1 are consumed positive regression allocations. F5-POLYGONAL-BOSSES-H1 is consumed completed negative regression evidence for zero output only. F5-PADS-H1 is consumed completed positive regression evidence for occurrence/aggregate-cardinality only: four attributed Pads carried 20 total defining face occurrences (average five), but the generic scanner did not record a per-Candidate cardinality vector or independently reconstruct top-versus-wall roles. F5-COUNTERSINKS-H1 and F5-BOSSES-H1 are consumed and inconclusive after invalid-model aborts; F5-DOUBLE-D-BORES-H1 is consumed and inconclusive after a zero-population selection. Those three inconclusive allocations produced no complete report and are not regression evidence. F5-HOLES-H1 remains independently sealed and unrevealed. Consumed allocations may not be reused or treated as sealed evidence.
policy.redistribution: The Kaggle dataset and generator repository report MIT, but the full dataset remains external. No MFTRCAD model is vendored by this manifest.
